【原视频简介】
From ancient seabed remains to self-healing Roman concrete and modern skyscrapers, limestone is the most transformative rock in human civilization.

In this Video, You Will Learn:

- *The Chemistry of Limestone:* How ancient marine skeletons formed calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) and why heating it to 900°C unlocks quicklime, plaster, and mortar.

- *The Canvas of Early Art:* How natural karst caves like Lascaux and Chauvet provided the smooth, durable background for humanity's earliest paintings.

- *Neolithic Innovations & Göbekli Tepe:* Discover the 9,000-year-old lime plaster statues of Ain Ghazal and the massive, hand-carved limestone pillars of Göbekli Tepe.

- *Pyramids & Self-Healing Roman Concrete:* How ancient Egypt used Tura limestone for the Great Pyramid and how Roman "hot mixing" created self-healing concrete that lasts millennia.

- *Industrial Revolution to the Modern World:* Learn how limestone revolutionized agriculture, purified steel production, and birthed 1824 Portland cement.

If you enjoyed this deep dive into civil engineering and materials science, hit the like button, subscribe for more breakdowns, and drop a comment with the next topic you want to see!
